newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: ING Baring lowers price target on BIC ADR.
newsitem.headline: ING Baring lowers price target on BIC ADR.

text.p: ING Baring Securities said Wednesday it had lowered its price target on the ADRs of Banco Industrial Colombiano to $19.60 for December 1997.
It predicted 1997 would see an increase in competition for the bank and a decline in its net interest rate.
ING Baring, however, maintained, its hold recommendation on the stock.

"We are expecting BIC to deliver a 15 percent growth of its book value before dividends, approximately in line with that of its domestic competitors Banco Ganadero and banco de Bogota," the ING Baring statement said.
"We believe BIC's profitability will remain limited over the next six months. Under the new price target, the total return on the stock would be 15 percent by December 1997," it added.
